system.description: You have access to a mortal who looks just like you — a twin, a long-lost relative, or simply someone very good at disguise. Unless ghouled, she will age and eventually no longer resemble you. Your fetch may move about during the day conducting your business and keeping up your semblance of a mortal life, but also commits actions for which you will be held responsible; she must be kept carefully informed of your relationships and dealings.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
